The Rockbusters Easter Climbing Camp is your chance to get out on the face during your holidays. Our destination is Kalymnos and there is no need for more  words. There are hundreds of sport routes and slabs to crank. And at this time of year you’ll find some really peaceful and empty crags to climb.

Climb as much as you want and we’ll provide you with our expert one-on-one video and photo analysis. If you’ve already got a bit of climbing experience and are looking to take it to the next level then this is the perfect time to do it.

  • Balance and foot placement to develop better technique for more confident climbing (leading comfortably F5 or more)

rows.title: ANDALUCIA CLIMBING
rows.body:
Got the wintertime blues and want to get outside and climb? 

Join Rockbusters in Spain's Andalusia, the most southerly extreme of the European mainland and home to some of the top winter climbing destinations on the Continent. Climbing here is as rich and varied as the local culture. From athletic overhangs to technical slabs, from tufas to crimps. With average rainfall very low and 5 - 6 hours of sunshine even throughout the winter, this is the place to go for some incredible climbing conditions when the weather is nasty elsewhere.

And there’s more to it. Forget about famous Spanish climbing destinations like Siurana, Margalef or Chulilla that get so much attention of the international climbing community. As well as a huge amount of visitors, unfortunately. Join us for this trip and discover a less known, non-crowded and superb-quality climbing spot you may have never heard of.

We’ll spend our time in Jaen, a Spanish province known as the largest olive oil-producing region of the world. Let us show you why Jaen is well worth visiting for its climbing though it lacks the reputation of the easily accessible areas in the north of the country. This place is much harder to get around without any knowledge of Spanish and thus it gets far less visitors and no crowds at its crags. The great thing is that it has much better rock than a lot of the well-known spots. 

With us, you can enjoy a week or two of great climbing in a breathtaking landscape shaped by mountain ranges surrounding the city of Jaen and the never ending olive groves.

As with all our trips, we welcome all novice and expert climbers excited to climb, and cater our coaching to each client’s individual needs. If you have any questions about your specific skill level, please contact us directly.

rows.title: Introduction to bouldering
rows.perex: If you totally newbie to bouldering or you have some indoor bouldering experience, this course is tailored 100% to you.
rows.body:
Originally bouldering was invented as a form of training for climibng with rope to practice specific moves, build bigger range of technical skills you have in pocket adn as a great power training. Througout the years it has developed into individual rock climibng disciplin with its own culture, ethics, grades, copetitions, ... In short, bouldering means climibng onto small rock formations using only crashpads to avoid hard falls. No ropes, no harness, no hard equipment, ...

 

For Rockbusters specially in places like Albarracin it has become love on first sight. 

 

On this Rockbustes course you can expect to learn:

  • all necessary equipment, how to handle it, how to choose it
  • how to spot
  • crash pads managements
  • how to fall
  • boulderig ethics (no noise, clean your chalk, no trash, 

 

Here’s a little look at what to expect when you join Rockbusters Coaching Programme.

 

Slab/vertical ground

Focusing on footwork, you will learn how to work with your balance, finding the most efficient and effective way to move on the rock. 

 

Overhangs

You will experience a wide range of techniques and skills in practice, which will increase your confidence and performance while climbing overhangs. You’ll develop skills to help you handle climbing steep rocks.

 

Flash / red point

This part of the course is well-suited to climbers who are confident enough with their balance, foot work and overhang technics, and who want to focus on more challenging boulders.

 

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course so you can also expect a hefty dollop of fun. We love what we do and that really comes across in all our tours and programmes. We like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the face.

Bouldering is also a great way for beginners to build confidence. Work on your strength, tone up and get your technique straight without having to take on any high routes before you’re ready.

We can’t mention Albarracin without talking about the stunning scenery. This place is simply incredible and a killer backdrop to it’s world-class boulders. We provide the complete climbing experience where technique and down time are equally important. Come and join the Rockbusters crew for bouldering and partying to see for yourself.

rows.title: Sport Climbing MASTERCLASS
rows.body:
Has your climbing been stagnant these past few seasons? Have you been training hard, but you haven’t seen the benefits of your training on real rock? Are you sick of one-hanging your projects? Does it bother you to keep blowing your onsights at the chains? Does it feel like no matter what you do, you just aren’t improving as quickly as you would like? 

 

If this sounds like you, then it is time to take your sport climbing to the next level. This camp will change your climbing game forever. With experts in training and performance from around the globe, this camp will not only alter the outcomes of your climbing season – it could change the trajectory of your climbing career.

 

It’s time to stop hoping you’ll get better and actually do something about it instead. Sign up today, and get ready to crush with Alizee, Dave, Paxti, Klemen, and the Rockbusters team. 

 

Paxti is one of the world’s best climbers and has coached pros like Chris Sharma, Adam Ondra, and Daniel Woods to name a few. Dave Graham has ascents of V16 and 5.15b under his belt - the man has redpointed a lot of hard rock climbs and has wisdom to impart to you. Klemen Becan, experience coach and passionate onsight climber, will give you tools to improve your onsight game (and he would know, he has onsighted 5.14c). Rounding out our all-star line-up is pro climber Alizee Dufraisse. From competition climbing to redpointing hard sport, Alizee will bring you what you need to know about trying hard on your projects. 

 

They say you’re the average of the five people you spend the most time with. So it stands to reason that a week or two with this group of experts, will open you up to new possibilities. You will climb with them, learn from them, and receive one on one attention to help you become the best climber you can be - and you might crack a few beers and hear some wild stories from them too.
rows.bodyMore:
Throughout the camp, you will work directly with the pros on the rock. But the learning does not stop there. Our panelists will be presenting seminars on a wide variety of important topics to help you maximize your performance.

Seminar topics:

  • Klemen Becan / On Sight, Flash
  • Dave Graham / Redpoint Climbing
  • Alizee / Specifics for Female Climbers
  • Pablo Scorza/ Biomechanical Functionality and Injury Prevention 

In addition to the seminars, you will receive individualized help to improve your climbing performance. This includes:

  • One on one coaching tailored to your needs and unique abilities.
  • Video analysis as your work through the projecting process
  • Lots of time on the rock to apply what you learn
  • Individual approach to your needs, will and level

 

As well as building confidence, strength, and ticking off some tough routes, you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! Here at Rockbusters, we take fun very seriously. We love what we do and it shows. Our first priority is that you enjoy your time with us. Sending is a lot easier when you are having a good time, anyway.

 

But send or no send, we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses defines us. The energy of the Rockbusters crew is contagious – the gang will have you smiling and motivated to climb hard all week long.

 

More information on sport climbing performance

 

The dawn of the modern age of sport climbing came with the innovation of the RED POINT. Redpointing is a style of climbing invented by German climber Kurt Albert in Frankenjura. If you have not heard the term before it means to free climb the route from the ground to the anchors without weighting the rope. Below are the three main categories of achievement in performance rock climbing.

  • On Sight -  redpointing the route on the first go without any additional knowledge or information than just personal observation of the route from the ground.

rows.body:
Has your climbing been stagnant these past few seasons? Have you been training hard, but you haven’t seen the benefits of your training on real rock? Are you sick of one-hanging your projects? Does it bother you to keep blowing your onsights at the chains? Does it feel like no matter what you do, you just aren’t improving as quickly as you would like? 

 

If this sounds like you, then it is time to take your sport climbing to the next level. This rock climbing coaching camp will change your climbing game forever. With these performance climbing coaches from around the globe, this camp will not only alter the outcomes of your climbing season – it could change the trajectory of your climbing career.

 

It’s time to stop hoping you’ll get better and actually do something about it instead. Sign up today, and get ready to crush with Alizee, Dave, Paxti, Klemen, and the Rockbusters rock climbing coaches. 

 

Let’s break down the kind of rock climbing coaching you will receive during your time at camp by reviewing our panel of rock climbing coaches, starting with Paxti Usobiaga. 

 

Paxti is one of the world’s best climbers and has acted as the performance climbing coach for pros like Chris Sharma, Adam Ondra, and Daniel Woods to name a few. Dave Graham has ascents of V16 and 5.15b under his belt - the man has redpointed a lot of hard rock climbs and has wisdom to impart to you. Klemen Becan, experienced coach and passionate onsight climber, will give you tools to improve your onsight game (and he would know, he has onsighted 5.14c). Rounding out our all-star line-up is pro climber Alizee Dufraisse. From competition climbing to redpointing hard sport, Alizee will bring you what you need to know about trying hard on your projects. With access to these all-star rock climbing coaches, this camp can’t get much better, right?

 

They say you’re the average of the five people you spend the most time with. So it stands to reason that a week or two with these performance climbing coaches, will open you up to new possibilities. You will climb with them, learn from them, and receive one on one attention to help you become the best climber you can be - and you might crack a few beers and hear some wild stories from them too. This camp will provide excellent rock climbing coaching and good times too.

 

Throughout the camp, you will work directly with the pros on the rock. But the learning does not stop there. In addition to climbing, you will enjoy seminars on important topics as part of this rock climbing coaching course.

Place yourself 600m above the ground with stunning view of the big mountains trying to sort out what peace of gear you need to use in this small crag, your arms totally pumped having your legs dancing Elvis Presly rock’n’roll rhythm. Scary, frustrating, mentaly exhausting, super challenging, … and 100% freaky awesome. This is traditional climbing in its purest form.

 

This trad climbing course is your ticket to new climbing adventures, breathtaking places around the world and special feelings coming from your achievements. The ability to climb trad opens new horizons and will allow you to explore some of the worlds’ best and most iconic climbing routes. If you wanna take your climbing to another level, learn what trad gear you need and how to place it, build safe anchors, abseil (rapel) down, …

rows.perex: Unique way how to get week of coaching and possibilitiy to exchange experiences from Edu Marin, guy who has send the harderst multipich route in China and UIAGM guide Pablo who has opened big wall routes in Himalayas. With Rockbusters you climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE!
rows.body:
Putting your eyes on some harder and longer climbs but it is way to intimidating for you to hit it? This course led by Pablo Ruiz Seco, UIAGM guide and a past member of youth alpine Spanish team,  as well as pro climber, Edu Marin who has red pointed worlds hardest multipitch roof climb in China called Walhala 9a+ shows you the best and safe way how to approach hard multiptich climbing. 

 

No matter if you are experienced multipitch climber approaching bigger difficulty or if you are confident single pitch sport climber searching for the same experience and satisfaction of climbing hard on multipitch routes. We will go through all the safety technical things you need to handle, show you the best and fastest way to handle it all to be able to move fast and efficiently. 

 

The importance in multipitch climbing is not only the side of perfect technical hadeling of your equipment. As most of the routes are in mountain surroundings and higher altitude, one needs to be able to plan things according to your potential, weather, to be able to see potential risks, evaluate the momental situation and know when and how to bail. When aiming for a hard multipitch climb everything needs to happen perfectly. On this course we make sure you know it all. We show you how to plan your day out, get ready technically and mentaly to attack. Rest is up to you!

 

  • maximum quality and quantity of climbing

  • individual approach to your needs and level

  • one-on-one coaching

  • video analysis
rows.bodyMore:
While some guides may only help you to get up the routes, in this course, we make sure you become a competent multipitch climber for all your adventures to come. Over the course of a week, you will learn about rope management, become literate in multipitch safety, and of course the best way to learn things is to do them as much as possible so you spend a lot of time climbing the variety of beautiful routes in Riglos.

 

Here is what we planned for you. Of course it all depends everyone's level, weather, will, … and can change flexibly:

 

  • Building safe belays

  • Rope management and handling

  • Abseils and retreats for returning to the ground

  • Communication techniques when climbing a multi-pitch route 

  • Hanging belays

  • Self-rescue skills - worth knowing if you want to make it home safely

  • Trip planning: how to use a guidebook effectively

  • Risk assessment and management

  • Equipment education

  • Climbing techniques – efficient movement

  • Fear management – fear of falling, fear of failure

  • Mental preparation, concentration

  • Choosing the right strategy before and when on the wall 

  • Climbing a project/projects using all the knowledge from first 3 days

  • Ongoing coaching and support from camp staff

  • Evening analysis of the day, tips, consultations

  • Individual coaching and guiding

 

 

At Rockbusters, we have one priority. We wanna deliver the best quality and quantity of climbing without any compromises. Of course this needs to happen in a safe and fun way. That is why we do work only with professional rock climbing guides and coaches with experience. In this camp we will make sure you understand critical safety protocols, but once we have safety covered, it’s time to enjoy climbing to its fullest.

Croatia, Slovenia, Albania, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Serbia, Monte Negro, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria and Greece, what do they have in common? It is all part of Balkan peninsula. The word Balkan comes from Turkis and it means Mountains and believe us, this mountain has a great rock to climb. Now it is pretty clear why we are heading this way, right?


Apart from great culture, food, drinks and welcome local people, Balkan offers amazing known crags such as Paklenica in Croatia or Osp in Slovenia. There are also tons of unknown rock climbing spots and it is about time to go and punish it. Klemen Becan with his great knowledge of local situations and conditions is gonna guide us through one of the coolest parts of Europe in terms of nature, culture and of course ROCK!


Using Adria and SunLiving camper vans as transportation and accommodation units which gives us great freedom, flexibility and comfort. There is La Sportiva and Singing Rock DEMO option every day. Looks like we are set to ROCK ‘N’ ROLL!

Multi-pitch climbing is used when climbing long routes on big walls where more than one length of rope is needed. It can vary between 2 or 25 or more lengths. One length we do call pitch. Your improvement is the goal number one here but we are sitll Rockbusters, community of higly motivated climbers for who climbing is not just a sport, it’s what we eat, drink, breathe and sleep - it’s what we live for. This week is for those who are stuck with a certain grade and no matter how hard you train the grade is still the same and desired progress is not happening. This week is about starting to believe in unbelievable, confidence and finding things inside you you do not think you have. It is about getting out and beyond your comfort zone.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programmes. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

 

Patxi sport climbing & bouldering performance analysis

Climbing performance is defined by the combination of these three components, mental power, physical power and technique skills. We can be discussing how big part each component has in your climbing performance but it is undoubtedly clear to all of us, performance climbers, we need to have it all sharp and at 100% to get to our total limit no matter you are a sport climber, boulderer or you are aiming for hard big wall climbs.

Who could be the better person to analyze that than Patxi Usobiaga, ex world champ, climbing training monster saying “my talent is to be able to suffer”, one of the world’s best climbers and has coached pros like Chris Sharma, Adam Ondra, and Daniel Woods to name a few. Lets meet with Patxi for a week climbing and training session, send some cool on-sights, flashes or red points in his home destination of Oliana and find out where your main limitation is and how to improve your overall climbing performance and how to climb BETTER, HARDER and MORE!

Mental power (fear, concentration, motivation, frustration, …)

Experience the Best of Indian Climbing: Hampi & Badami

 

Join Rockbusters on an unforgettable 2-week journey through India’s most iconic climbing destinations. Our carefully crafted winter expedition takes you to the magical landscapes of Hampi and Badami, offering the perfect blend of world-class bouldering and sport climbing in environments steeped in ancient history and breathtaking beauty.

 

The Ultimate Winter Escape

 

Available December through February, this trip escapes the cold northern winter for the perfect climbing conditions of southern India. With warm days, cool evenings, and dry weather, you’ll experience optimal friction on Hampi’s golden granite boulders and ideal conditions on Badami’s striking red sandstone walls.

 

Hampi: Bouldering Paradise

 

Immerse yourself in the surreal landscape of Hampi, where thousands of granite boulders are scattered among ancient temple ruins and banana plantations. This UNESCO World Heritage site offers a unique bouldering experience with:

 

  • Endless problems ranging from beginner-friendly slabs to challenging roofs and dynos
  • Golden granite with exceptional friction and diverse climbing styles
  • Problems for all levels, from V0 to V12+
  • Magical sunsets over boulder fields that create an otherworldly climbing atmosphere

 

 

Badami: Sport Climbing Excellence

 

Experience the thrill of sport climbing on Badami’s striking red sandstone cliffs:

 

  • Routes ranging from 5.10 to 5.14, suitable for intermediate to advanced climbers
  • Unique tufa formations and technical face climbing
  • Multi-pitch options with panoramic views of the ancient city

More Than Just Climbing

Four Weeks, Four Legendary Climbing Destinations

Experience the ultimate Spanish climbing odyssey with Rockbusters' 4-week road trip through Spain's most iconic limestone destinations. From the enchanted formations of Cuenca to the legendary crimps of Siurana, immerse yourself in a transformative journey of maximum climbing and expert coaching. rows.body:
Embark on the climbing adventure of a lifetime with Rockbusters’ Ultimate Spanish Road Trip. This four-week journey takes you through Spain’s most iconic sport climbing destinations, delivering an unparalleled vertical experience that will transform your climbing forever. Unlike typical climbing holidays, this immersive road trip isn’t about ticking a few routes and sightseeing—it’s about total climbing immersion, pushing boundaries, and discovering what you’re truly capable of on the rock. Our signature Rockbusters approach maximizes every moment on the wall, with expert coaching to help you break through plateaus and conquer routes you never thought possible.

 

The nomadic spirit of climbing comes alive as we travel in our fleet of fully-equipped camper vans, moving between breathtaking landscapes while forming an intimate climbing community. Each location has been meticulously chosen for its unique character and world-class routes, creating a progression that builds your skills and confidence week by week. From the mesmerizing tufas of Cuenca to the technical precision demanded by Siurana’s crimps, this isn’t just a climbing trip—it’s a transformative journey that will redefine your relationship with the vertical world.

rows.bodyMore:
WEEK 1: CUENCA - THE ENCHANTED CITY OF ROCK

 

Nestled in the heart of central Spain, our journey begins in the otherworldly landscape of Cuenca. This hidden gem combines the medieval charm of its UNESCO World Heritage hanging houses with some of Spain’s most spectacular and underrated climbing. The region offers a perfect introduction to Spanish limestone with its variety of climbing styles and difficulty ranges.

 

Climbing Highlights:

  • Ciudad Encantada sector with its bizarre rock formations and routes from 6a to 8b

  • El Juego de Bolas features overhanging pocketed walls, ideal for power endurance

  • Mangraneras’ vertical technical face climbing with delicate footwork challenges

  • Over 500 routes across multiple sectors, allowing progression for all levels

 

Rockbusters Experience:

  • Daily coaching sessions focused on movement efficiency and Spanish limestone techniques

  • Evening video analysis to break down your climbing and set personalized goals

  • Rest day excursion to the historic hanging houses and narrow streets of medieval Cuenca

  • Community cooking and first week bonding activities to build our climbing tribe

 

 

WEEK 2: COSTA BLANCA - MEDITERRANEAN LIMESTONE PARADISE

 

The journey continues as we head east to the sun-drenched Costa Blanca, where Mediterranean climate meets world-class climbing. Known for its perfect winter conditions, this coastal climbing paradise offers an astonishing diversity of routes set against the backdrop of the sparkling blue sea. With over 3,000 routes spread across dozens of crags, Costa Blanca represents the ultimate in accessible Spanish sport climbing.

 

Climbing Highlights:

  • Echo Valley’s compact limestone with technical face climbing

  • The legendary Penon d’Ifach sea cliff towering 332m above the Mediterranean

  • Sella’s vast selection of routes, from beginner-friendly to project-worthy challenges

  • Stunning multi-pitch opportunities for those seeking the full Spanish experience

 

Rockbusters Experience:

  • Focus on volume climbing to build endurance on the region’s longer routes

  • Specialized clinics on redpointing strategy and mental preparation

  • Beach recovery sessions and mobility work to maintain peak performance

  • Evening presentations on climbing history and the development of Spanish climbing

 

 

WEEK 3: CHULILLA - THE TUFA KINGDOM

 

As we reach the midpoint of our journey, we travel inland to the spectacular gorge of Chulilla. This vertical paradise features towering walls up to 200 meters high flanking the crystalline Turia River. Chulilla has exploded onto the international climbing scene for good reason—its distinctive tufa formations and endurance-testing routes create an unforgettable climbing experience that will push your stamina to new heights.

 

Climbing Highlights:

  • The magnificent El Balcón sector, with its 3D climbing on tufas and stalactites

  • Las Cuevas offers cave-like features and powerful overhanging terrain

  • Oasis sector for technical vertical climbing with smaller holds

  • Routes frequently reaching 30+ meters, demanding physical and mental endurance

 

Rockbusters Experience:

  • Endurance training protocols specifically designed for Chulilla’s long routes

  • Specialized tufa climbing workshops to master this unique Spanish feature

  • Recovery river sessions in the crystal-clear waters of the Turia

  • Tactical rest day at El Alborache natural pools to rejuvenate mind and body

 

 

WEEK 4: SIURANA - THE CRIMSON CROWN

 

Our Spanish odyssey culminates in the hallowed grounds of Siurana, arguably Spain’s most iconic climbing destination. Perched atop a dramatic cliff overlooking rolling hills and olive groves, the medieval village of Siurana provides the perfect backdrop for the technical crimps and pockets that have challenged the world’s best climbers for decades. This final week represents the apex of our journey, where all the skills developed over the previous weeks converge.

 

Climbing Highlights:

  • El Pati sector, home to Chris Sharma’s legendary La Rambla (9a+)

  • L’Olla offers perfect orange and red walls with crimpy technical routes

  • Can Melafots with its concentration of world-class 7th and 8th grade lines

  • The historic El Diedro Mágico for a taste of Siurana’s traditional climbing heritage

 

Rockbusters Experience:

  • Project week: apply all accumulated skills to send your Spanish dream route

  • Advanced redpointing tactics with personalized coaching on your projects

  • Final night celebration at the historic Siurana village with traditional Catalan cuisine

  • Comprehensive video documentation of your four-week progression journey

rows.title: KNOTS & STONE: Czech Climbing Tradition
rows.perex:
Tower Craft: Czech Sandstone Mastery

Discover the birthplace of European free climbing amid towering sandstone spires. Our 5-day immersive course takes you deep into the traditions of Czech sandstone climbing, where metal protection is forbidden and centuries-old ethics reign supreme. Learn specialized knotting techniques, delicate footwork, and authentic climbing methods passed down through generations of local climbers. Master the art of ascending these fragile natural monuments using only textile protection while experiencing one of climbing's most pure and historic traditions. Limited to just 6 participants per course—this is traditional climbing in its truest form.
rows.body:
EXPERIENCE THE LEGENDARY CZECH SANDSTONE TOWERS

Duration: 5 Days
Location: Bohemian Switzerland & Adršpach-Teplice Rocks
Difficulty: Intermediate to Advanced
Group Size: Maximum 6 participants
Price: €895 per person
2026 Dates: May 15-19, June 12-16, September 4-8

 

 

COURSE OVERVIEW

Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable adventure on the legendary sandstone towers of the Czech Republic. This specialized course introduces climbers to the unique ethics, techniques, and traditions of Czech sandstone climbing – a distinctive style that has influenced generations of climbers worldwide.

Czech sandstone climbing represents one of the purest forms of traditional climbing, where metal protection is forbidden, and climbers rely on knotted slings, textile rings, and occasional fixed rings for protection. With routes dating back to the early 1900s, you’ll be participating in a climbing tradition with deep historical roots.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL LEARN

  • Specialized Protection Techniques: Master the art of placing knotted slings and textile protection

  • Delicate Footwork: Develop precise movement on the fragile, sometimes crumbly sandstone

  • Route Finding: Navigate complex tower systems with minimal marking

  • Traditional Ethics: Understand and practice the strict local climbing code

  • Tower Summiting: Experience the unique joy of topping out on freestanding sandstone spires

  • Rope Management: Learn efficient systems for the unique multi-pitch environment

 

 

DAILY SCHEDULE

Day 1: Introduction
Introduction to Czech sandstone ethics and history. Equipment check and basic techniques practice on smaller formations.

Day 2-5: Progressive Climbing
Daily excursions to different climbing areas with increasing difficulty. Morning technique workshops followed by guided climbs on selected routes.

Day 6: Challenge Day
Attempt a classic multi-pitch route on one of the iconic towers. Farewell dinner.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience: Minimum 1 year of outdoor climbing experience

  • Technical Ability: Confident leading trad routes at UIAA VI (5.10a)

  • Fitness Level: Good overall fitness for approaches and full days of climbing

  • Equipment: Standard trad rack plus specialized equipment (rental available)

 

 

WHY CLIMB CZECH SANDSTONE WITH ROCKBUSTERS?

  • Expert Local Guides: All our instructors are certified with deep knowledge of local ethics and routes

  • Historical Immersion: Visit the birthplace of free climbing in continental Europe

  • Small Groups: Maximum 6 participants ensure personalized instruction

  • All-Inclusive: Accommodation, meals, transportation, and equipment rental included

  • Environmental Approach: Learn climbing techniques that preserve the fragile sandstone

 

 

“The Czech sandstone experience transformed my climbing. There’s nothing quite like the feeling of summiting these towers using traditional methods that have remained unchanged for over a century.” – Previous Course Participant

rows.title: Bouldering Weekend with Alizée Dufraisse
rows.perex:
Master Swiss Granite with a World Cup Climber

You're strong enough. Now find out what you're actually capable of.
Three days. Three legendary venues. Six climbers max. Learn from French pro Alizée Dufraisse at Chironico, Cresciano, and Magic Wood — and finally make your gym strength count on real rock.
rows.body:
You Climb Well. Outdoors Just Feels Like a Different Sport.

 

You're solid at the gym. But on real rock, the friction feels off, the beta isn't obvious, and committing to high moves is a whole mental game nobody trained you for.

 

That gap closes here. Direct coaching from someone who's competed at the IFSC World Cup level and sent V12+ projects across Europe — applied entirely to your climbing, your body, your hesitations.

 

 

Three Days That Rewire How You Move

 

Trust Friction
Stop second-guessing tiny crystals and steep slopers. Learn the physics of granite and feel what your shoes are actually capable of.

Read Rock
Break down complex problems fast. Find the rest positions others miss, and decode beta that matches your body — not someone else's.

Commit High
Build the mental game that separates outdoor climbers from gym climbers. Learn to move through uncertainty instead of freezing at it.

 

 

Three Days in one of the Three Classics

 

  • Chironico — Massive boulder fields, problems for every style
  • Cresciano — Sunny terraces, technical features, unforgettable movement
  • Magic Wood — Dense forest, world-class hard lines, pure atmosphere

 

What's Included

 

Six climbers maximum — this is mentorship, not a clinic. Alizée works with you on every problem you attempt.

  • All crash pads provided
  • Professional spotting throughout
  • Local area knowledge and beta
  • Personalized coaching on every attempt
  • Zero logistics stress — show up and climb

 

You arrange: accommodation, meals, transport, and personal gear. Need local recommendations? Reach out — we'll point you to the best climber-friendly spots.

 

 

Climbers Who Made the Jump

 

"Alizée helped me send my first V7 outdoors after months of trying. Her movement cues made everything click."
— Sarah M., Aranea+ Member

"I went from scared on V4 outdoors to confidently projecting V7. Her coaching is next level."
— Julia R.

"Finally understood how to read granite. The small group meant real coaching on every single attempt — not just watching someone else climb."
— Marc T.

 

 

The Essentials

 

  • When: Full weekend, Friday evening through Sunday
  • Group size: 6 maximum, 3 minimum
  • Included: Coaching, crash pads, spotting, and local guiding
  • Not included: Accommodation, meals, transport, personal gear

 

 

Only 6 Spots. They Go Fast.

 

Alizée's coaching, three world-class venues, and a group small enough that you actually improve — this sells out in days.
